fullRepositoryRun.detail: The repository-wide run was not green because historical source-manifest checks, including the intentionally unmodified C01 v1 evidence, still compare old frozen hashes with an evolved worktree; concurrent C02/C08/C04/F03/C03 evidence changes and one G1 file-count assertion also remained unresolved. This supplement does not rewrite those historical artifacts or claim a full-suite pass.

verifiedAssertions: A real P1 Synthetic C11 table-backed KnowledgeEvidenceRef opens through the C01 identity BFF and replaceable portal shell only after it matches the current C10 document and complete Original, Page, Section, Table and Chunk chain.
The EvidenceRef immutable identifier is recomputed before any source is opened, then all fifteen source coordinates, hashes and versions are reconciled with the current C10 catalog record.
The current Principal is resolved again and must retain the exact principal scope bound to the EvidenceRef and a current C10 read ACL.
C10 withdrawal or deletion makes the old citation explicitly unavailable without returning its prior C10 locator.
A current Principal without source access receives an explicit ACCESS_DENIED unavailable item rather than a stale or cross-user citation.
The BFF rejects any unavailable CitationItem that still carries a C10 resource, locator or title reference.
limitations: This supplement uses the real C10 and C11 in-process Synthetic implementations with memory stores; it is not a browser, distributed-service, durable-database, object-store or production integration test.
The C11 EvidenceRef reader and current Principal reader are injected Product Core ports; a durable cross-process EvidenceRef registry and its recovery behavior are not implemented or verified here.
The P1 citation remains private to the original Human Principal and exact principal-scope hash. Citation sharing, newly granted access and user-facing recovery flows are not verified.
The returned synthetic C10 references prove safe logical source selection, not a production document viewer, download endpoint or signed object URL.
The stricter CitationItem status and reason fields take effect for the v5.3 C01-AC05 supplement; they do not retroactively alter the original P1 Gate decision or historical evidence.
This supplement does not change any recorded P1 status, reopen or approve G1, enter P2, authorize P3 enterprise integration, or prove production readiness.
